annotation.interpretation_a: Clients MUST accept DHE sizes of 2048, 2560, 3072, and 4096 bits.
annotation.interpretation_b: Clients MUST accept DHE sizes up to, but not including, 4096 bits (e.g., 2048, 2560, 3072 bits).
annotation.justification: The phrase "up to 4096 bits" can be interpreted in two ways: inclusive (allowing 4096 bits) or exclusive (allowing only sizes less than 4096 bits). This difference affects implementation, as a client might or might not accept a 4096-bit DHE key exchange.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'up to 4096 bits' is inclusive or exclusive. A clear statement of whether 4096 is permitted would resolve the ambiguity.
